description.text: The opening view is an extreme wide shot of a burning battlefield at dusk: churned earth, broken stone, and sheets of flame stretch to the horizon under a low ceiling of smoke. A huge black dragon beats low across the field, its wings spread wide enough to cast a racing shadow over the fire. A knight in battered plate armour is braced in the saddle, reins held tight, as embers and smoke stream past the camera. The dragon's scales catch the orange glow; the knight's dented helmet and scuffed pauldrons show the wear of long combat. The ground burns beneath them, and the air is thick with heat and ash.
The dragon sweeps low over the burning ground, wings beating hard, while the knight holds his seat.
Heavy wingbeats, roaring flames, and a rushing wind fill the air.
Sparks and embers scatter across the frame as the dragon's shadow races over the fire.
Smoke rolls up from the burning field, briefly veiling the horizon behind the riders.
The camera holds a static shot.

Close on the knight, the black dragon's neck surging beneath him. He grips the saddle, leans forward against the wind, and sets his jaw as the battered plate rattles with every wingbeat. Firelight slides across the scratched metal of his helmet and breastplate; smoke curls around the ridged scales behind him. The view tightens on the knight's effort to hold his position while the dragon drives onward. Heat shimmer and flying ash soften the background, and the roar of the flames presses close.
The knight tightens his grip on the saddle and leans into the wind as the dragon surges beneath him.
The wingbeats deepen and the fire roar swells around the riders.
A gust of sparks and ash streaks past the knight's shoulder, catching the firelight.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The dragon banks and sweeps onward over the burning ground, carrying the knight away across the field. Fire and smoke tear past as the dragon's wings tilt against the orange sky, and the knight holds his seat, plate flashing in the shifting glow. Below, the battlefield falls away in patches of flame, broken ground, and drifting ash. The flight remains low and powerful, the heat and wind pressing close as the burning field recedes behind them.
The dragon banks and carries the knight onward across the burning field.
Wingbeats, fire roar, and rushing wind continue, fading slightly as the pair sweep away.
The burning ground falls behind, embers and smoke trailing across the wide frame.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.
